blocks.text: New York, United States — New York postponed the iconic Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade to Saturday due to a major storm, a first in the event’s 100-year history, as extreme weather lashing the US East Coast caused power outages and travel delays. The “Nor’easter” storm, which brought torrential rain and strong winds on Thursday, disrupted one of the country’s busiest travel seasons for millions of people hitting the road and flying around during the holiday. Power outages were affecting more than 400,000 people — across a number of states including Virginia, North Carolina, and New Jersey, according to poweroutage.us, a platform that […]...
